title: WHIL’s Picture of The Week
content:
25th February 2015

Up close and personal this week, with Johnny Borrell of Razorlight.

If you browse my portfolio, you’ll notice there are quite a few close up images of performers. It’s quite a challenge to nail one of these shots, for me – the eyes have to be sharp when photographing someone and it makes the shot that little harder when they’re jumping around on stage. 

This image was taken at Volksfest in Plymouth, which has almost doubled in size in the past 3 years I’ve been photographing there – this year see’s over 200 performers take to the stage including 90’s pop sensations Atomic Kitten and East17.

 

As always, we’re interested in getting our reader photos as Photo of the Week. If you have any images you’d like to share with the world (well, mainly Bristol) please send them to contact@thefixmagazine.com with the subject ‘Photo of the week’.

Will Fahy
